_comment: TRACKING DAY template — a single-day campaign config for scripts/postprocess_report.py using the `prep` path (mission inputs synthesised from a dump dir). scripts/quicklook_report.py fills every <PLACEHOLDER> from flights.json + meta.json; a human can also fill it by hand. Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the code (every read is .get()) — but never put one inside a fixed-length list row (flights_pdt / laps_pdt triples, init.day, init.ant). Numeric placeholders (<ANT_LAT> <ANT_LON> <ANT_HAE_M> <YYYY> <MM> <DD>) MUST become numbers. Build: cd scripts && micromamba run -n sensorenv python postprocess_report.py <this file>  (or quicklook_report.py --build-only <this file> for timings).

_comment_placeholders.<DAY>: YYYY-MM-DD of the test day (day id MUST be a date). AUTO: --day
_comment_placeholders.<M/D>: short date for titles, e.g. 8/26. AUTO from --day
_comment_placeholders.<RUN8>: first 8 hex of the run collection. AUTO: meta.json run_id8 / run, else flights.json runs[0].run
_comment_placeholders.<MRU>: unit number for the page sub-line. AUTO: meta.json mru when present, else left as 'MRU?'
_comment_placeholders.<DUMP_DIR>: ONE dump dir with mavlink/, tracks/, meta.json (archiver layout or quickdump/dump_run_window layout). AUTO: first --dumps entry (prep reads a single dir — pass the dir that covers both flights)
_comment_placeholders.<TARGET_PATTERN>: target truth csv name/glob under <DUMP_DIR>/mavlink/, e.g. mav14550_1_1.csv (a glob picks the LARGEST match). AUTO: --target, else flights.json tracking.target + .csv
_comment_placeholders.<ANT_LAT>,<ANT_LON>,<ANT_HAE_M>: per-deployment antenna origin. AUTO: meta.json 'antenna' or 'antenna_origin_lat_lon_haeM' (or --ant lat,lon,hae). prep.ant_hae_m must equal init.ant[2]
_comment_placeholders.<HH:MM:SS>: PDT clock strings (fixed UTC-7 converter). AUTO: flights.json flights[].t0_pdt/t1_pdt (flight windows) and segments[type=loop] (laps)
_comment_placeholders.<OUT_ROOT>: where <OUT_ROOT>/<DAY>/report.html + Rollup.html land. AUTO: --out. Put it under the :8899 http.server root and set server_base to share
_comment_placeholders.<GEOID_N>: site HAE-minus-MSL in metres (Seawall -31.4). AUTO: meta.json geoid_n_m, else --geoid-n (default -31.4)

title: Quick look — <DAY> (tracking)
_comment_title: page <title>/<h1> of Rollup.html. Analyst: rename for the real campaign ('Seawall Week of 9-14 — Campaign Report')
sub: MRU<MRU> · run <RUN8> · quick-look build (auto-filled from flights.json; narratives pending)
_comment_server_base: '' = no link rewrite in Rollup_standalone.html. Set to http://172.18.1.28:8899/<out_root basename> when out_root is under the served root
_comment_rollup_html: NARRATIVE (analyst): the campaign in one arc, appended under the auto Days table of the Overall Rollup tab

days._comment: ONE tracking day. tracking_tab needs EXACTLY TWO flight windows (fast2_F1/F2): one real flight -> split it at a lap boundary; more than two -> pick two (quicklook takes the first two, --flights 1,3 to choose). Tabs = Summary + one per flight_keys entry ('F<flight>R<lap>' -> 'Flight N · Lap N').
days.title: <M/D> — Tracking (2 flights × 2 laps)
days._comment_title: plain factual title; the parenthetical becomes the rollup card descriptor. AUTO

prep._comment_flights_pdt: AUTO from flights.json t0_pdt/t1_pdt (clock part). Exactly two rows.
prep._comment_laps_pdt: OPTIONAL lap windows keyed '<flight>,<lap>' -> one 'Flight N · Lap N' tab each (list them in flight_keys as F<flight>R<lap>). AUTO from flights.json segments[type=loop]; a flight without loops gets one lap = the whole flight. DELETE this key (and use flight_keys F1R1/F2R1) for one tab per flight. Lap windows inside the flight; the last lap runs to landing (no landing exclusion on prep days).
prep._comment_gate_m: constant: median track-to-truth gate (m) selecting the flight's tracks; 350 is the standard

days._comment_notes_html:
NARRATIVE (analyst): the Summary tab's key-findings block — one

Key message: …

(+ optional
    ) on az bias, coverage, accuracy, continuity. Empty -> a 'not yet written' placeholder renders (prep days never fall back to the 8/26 text).
days._comment_flight_keys: tab order; every key must exist in laps_pdt (or be F<n>R1 when laps_pdt is absent). AUTO
days._comment_key_message_html: NARRATIVE (analyst): rollup card column 2, e.g. 'Cal applied — residual az −1.45°; 22–27 m corrected; continuity association-limited'
days._comment_numbers_html:
rollup card column 3, labelled line-per-metric ('Az bias: −1.45°
Coverage: 85%
Median error: 68 m raw → 27 m corrected'). AUTO from flights.json tracking (az_bias_deg, coverage_pct, med_horiz_err_m[_azcorr]) — verify before publishing

_comment_radar_rollup: The Radar Rollup tab is OPTIONAL and off in a quick look (absent key = no tab, ~15-40 s saved). To enable, rename '_radar_rollup_disabled' to 'radar_rollup' (quicklook: --radar-rollup). Its target csv must match mavlink/mav14550*.csv (toxic_zones.pick_truth_csvs).
